items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Couple of gigs as a trio. He wanted somebody to go with him, and I could go along.

ctx.x: Couple of gigs as a trio. He wanted somebody to go with him, and I could go along. I played enough banjo to give a . . . to stay in tune. I’ve been learning this all the time. We made a couple of tours out there in Mississippi.
Did you stay overnight, different towns?
